items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And Johnny would always be around somewhere... I'd go by there and listen to him... we became acquainted that way

ctx.x: Now, he at one time got a saxophone.

Yeah. Well, he bought a saxophone, because he thought he could learn how to play it. You know, saxophone was getting to be kind of popular up there in Boston after Johnny got one. And everybody was talking about Johnny Hodges. So he thought he would get a saxophone too.
No, no, no, he got his before Johnny had one. Because at that time when Johnny got one, Howard was playing saxophone...
